title: Sky Guard Runner
heading: Sky Guard
help: Pick a step and click Green flag. Aim with the mouse over the stage; click or press Space to shoot.

2.name: Shoot
2.note: A click clones the Bullet; it points like the cannon and moves 12 steps until the edge.

3.name: Meteors
3.note: Clones fall from random places; a bullet that touches one pops it and scores.

4.name: Lives and waves
4.note: A landed meteor costs a life; speed = 2 + score / 10. This is the whole game.
